description: This file defines a React component called ErrorBoundary that handles runtime errors in React component trees, providing error boundary functionality with custom UI and error message display.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component class that acts as an error boundary, catching runtime errors in child components and displaying fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component with default state.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method to update state when an error is caught, indicating an error has occurred.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Lifecycle method that logs the error to the console for debugging or monitoring.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the fallback UI if an error has occurred; otherwise renders children components.
